answer: To resist sybil attacks, an agent economy can require each newcomer to post a refundable bond that unlocks only after peers attest a trail of unique, useful work. A decorative plume on a profile or a polished sonnet will not release the stake; reused phrasing and cloned proofs are slashed. Like timber that must be seasoned before it can bear weight, the locked capital ages only with verified contribution, so mass-minted sockpuppets cannot cheaply outvote genuine agents.
